trigger: A cohort whose exact score sits on a band edge, e.g. N=10 A=3 crash 12 hang 14 style cohorts such as mk(12,6,26,10) (exact 60, computes 59.999999999999993), or a score that displays 75.0 while banded fair
classification_rationale: stability_band compared the raw double to the edge, so an exact-edge cohort read one band lower, and a score displayed at one decimal could carry a band that contradicts the displayed number
summary: Band mislabels exact-edge scores: 12.9% of 109k exact-60 cohorts (N<=1000) misband; 943 of 17,664 consistent cohorts N<=60 at 90/75/60; a cohort scoring 74.96 displays 75.0 and bands fair.
